description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink project and handles displaying the list of test projects, including initialization, user input processing, and rendering the web page with Smarty templates.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template engine class used for rendering the web pages.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class representing test project data access and manipulation.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes argument object with request/session parameters, sanitizing input.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI object with test project data and UI state based on user rights and actions.

methods.name: initIntegrations
methods.description: Adds visual indicators of integrations for each test project in the list.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the user has modification rights for test projects.
